text: dsh-tool-surface-proof 是一个面向 DSH 的工具，用于核对部署中记录的模型可见工具面是否符合人工批准的哈希清单。它通过 DSH 工具接口提供清点与验证能力：清点清单中的表面和工具数量，验证批准表面与观测记录的身份、权限模式、呈现模式、工具 schema、顺序和时间新鲜度。验证结果列出差异类别并生成内容寻址报告，供部署升级后的审查使用。适合需要比较多个 agent scope 下工具暴露状态的维护者；它依赖部署方提供观测记录，不连接外部服务，文件验证需指定本地工作区清单及报告目录。

dsh-tool-surface-proof compares recorded DSH tool surfaces with approved hashes. It checks tool identities, schemas, modes, order, and observation freshness, then reports differences. File verification can save a content-addressed result. Maintainers provide the deployment observations.
升级 DSH 后，怎么确认各 agent 能看到的工具仍和批准清单一致？
想检查记录下来的工具 schema 或权限模式有没有发生漂移。
Compare recorded DSH tool surfaces with approved hashes after a deployment change.
dsh-tool-surface-proof 的功能「工具面差异核验」：比较批准清单和部署观测，报告缺失或新增表面、工具增删、schema 或元数据变化及可选顺序漂移。通过 DSH 验证工具提交清单参数，并返回差异摘要。
dsh-tool-surface-proof 的功能「工作区报告落盘」：对比本地清单后生成内容寻址的 JSON 报告，并回读校验写入结果。通过验证工具指定工作区相对清单路径与报告目录，结果不含原始工具 schema。

dsh-tool-surface-proof README · dsh-tool-surface-proof：**Maintainer / Author：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen) · [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)**

Content-addressed evidence that the **actual recorded model-visible tool surface of one DeepSeek Harness deployment** still matches an approved lock across agent scopes, permission modes and presentation modes.

dsh-tool-surface-proof README · dsh-tool-surface-proof：DeepSeek Harness already generates an official default Tool Schema Catalog by booting shipped tool plugins. `dsh-mcp-lens` already compresses large MCP catalogs and offers schema-budget checks. This plugin does neither. It verifies deployment-specific, explicitly recorded envelopes: for example, whether an owner/native surface and a reader/native surface still expose exactly the approved tool identities and schemas after an upgrade.

dsh-tool-surface-proof README · Evidence contract：Schema version 1 binds an exact deployment revision, evaluation time, freshness policy and one approved surface per `surfaceId`. Each surface declares `agentScope`, `permissionMode`, `presentationMode`, and ordered `{nameHash, schemaHash, position}` locks. Each observation records the same public dimensions plus the model-visible tool objects captured by a separate trusted recorder.

dsh-tool-surface-proof README · Evidence contract：The verifier detects missing or unexpected surfaces, scope/permission/presentation mismatch, added or removed tools, schema changes, optional order drift, stale/future observations, duplicate identities and revision mismatch. Reports contain only SHA-256 identities, counts and drift categories. They never return tool names, descriptions, schemas or raw business content.

dsh-tool-surface-proof README · Evidence contract：This plugin does not capture live runtime state, grant or deny permission, execute commands, connect to MCP servers, or prove that a recorder was honest. Use a trusted deployment-specific recorder to create the observation envelope and review the lock before approval.

dsh-tool-surface-proof README · CLI：```bash
dsh-tool-surface-proof inspect --manifest surface.json
dsh-tool-surface-proof verify --workspace-root . --manifest surface.json --artifact-dir artifacts
```

Verification reads one workspace-relative regular file, rejects symlinks and traversal, performs no network requests or subprocesses, and writes only one content-addressed JSON report below the explicit artifact directory with exclusive creation and read-back verification.

dsh-tool-surface-proof README · DSH and MCP：The DSH bundle exposes `dsh_tool_surface_inspect` and `dsh_tool_surface_verify`. The independent stdio MCP server exposes inline, filesystem-free equivalents. Both call the same interface-free core.

dsh-tool-surface-proof README · dsh-tool-surface-proof：作者 / 维护者：He Fangsheng (贺方升 / 贺去病; also known as Dosen)· [hequbing.com](https://www.hequbing.com)

为一个真实 DeepSeek Harness 部署的**模型可见工具面**生成内容寻址一致性证据，覆盖 agent scope、权限模式与呈现模式。

DSH 官方已经通过真实启动工具插件生成默认 Tool Schema Catalog；`dsh-mcp-lens` 也已经覆盖大型 MCP 目录压缩与 schema budget。本插件不复制这些能力，只验证部署态显式录制 envelope 是否仍等于人工批准的哈希锁。例如升级后，owner/native 与 reader/native 两个表面是否仍暴露完全相同的工具身份与 schema。

dsh-tool-surface-proof README · dsh-tool-surface-proof：版本 1 契约绑定部署 revision、评估时间、freshness 策略、批准 surface，以及每个 surface 的 `agentScope`、`permissionMode`、`presentationMode` 与有序 `{nameHash, schemaHash, position}`。验证器区分缺失/新增 surface、权限元数据错位、工具新增/删除、schema 改动、顺序漂移、陈旧/未来观测、重复身份和 revision 不一致。

报告只含 SHA-256、计数和差异类别，不返回工具名、描述、schema、业务正文或秘密。它不抓取实时运行时、不授权、不执行命令、不连接 MCP，也不证明录制器诚实；观测必须由部署方的可信录制器生成并人工审查批准锁。
